sections.text: Before starting the pump, the following steps should be checked

items:
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting; it 
 is clockwise.

The check must be carried out be qualified and competent 
 operators, starting the motor for a few second.
Filling the pump casing with the liquid.
Fill suction line with liquid and completely prime pump.
Turn rotation element by hand to make sure it rotates freely.
Tighten plugs in gauge and drain taps

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be 
 performed every one year as indicated by (Y1) in the above title block.
This pump is used to primary filter back wash.
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Mageed Elhenawe, tested at September 
 2008 revised by MDEP Co. Quality control Eng. Magdy Hegazy, accepted by 
 eng . Magdy Okba, and approved by Eng Ahmed Abdel Mageed Sowan
This document accepted by Eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC inspection & quality 
 control general Manager& MPIS coordinator, and certified by Eng Mohamed Nageeb 
 inspection & quality control's head sector.
Primary filter back wash pump | P-013A/B
MANUFACTURE | U.S.A
MODEL &TYPE | 11-6012-9 Horizontal End Suction Centrifugal Pump(LF)
NUMBER OF STAGES | 1
SPEED | 1450 R.P.M CW
POWER CONSUMED | 17 KW
LIQUID HANDED | Filtrated Water
CAPACITY | 340M/H
HEAD | 15 M
MOTOR POWER | 30 HP/4 POLE
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask ...etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor.
Isolate the pump mechanically by 
 closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be completely 
 drainage.
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid. Manual puller.
Feeler gauge, dial indicator.
Vibrometer straight edge, Rags.
Work to be 
carried out
Pump in 
operation
Check pump capacity, pressure and power .
Check the Noisy of the Pump.
Measure vibration level for bearings and compare it with the 
 setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do.
Check the Temperature of bearing
Check the leakage of the mechanical seal and change it if 
 needed
Pump out of operation
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value.
Adjust the mechanical seal leakage.
Adjust piping for leaks.
Check the fixation.
Starting the Pump
Before starting the pump, the following steps should be checked
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting; it 
 is clockwise.
The check must be carried out be qualified and competent 
 operators, starting the motor for a few second.
Filling the pump casing with the liquid.
Fill suction line with liquid and completely prime pump.
Turn rotation element by hand to make sure it rotates freely.
Tighten plugs in gauge and drain taps
Attendance 
and checking during operation of the pump, the following should be checked
Check discharge, pressure 
 and power.
Check the shaft seal for leaks.
Install coupling guard on flexible coupled unit.
Fully open gate valve (if any ) in suction line , and close 
 gate valve in discharge line.
Immediately after pump reaches full operating speed , slowly 
 open discharge gate valve until complete system flow is achieved
Check discharge piping for pressure leaks
Check suction and discharge piping for leaks , and make sure 
 for flange bolts are securely tighten need
